name: jerry-sdlc
description: Lightweight software delivery with bounded review, measured costs, and explicit release readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight delivery, UX checks, and explicit release readiness.
interface.longDescription: Defaults to one implementation owner and one reviewer, adds specialists for specific risks, bounds correction rounds, and records costs when available. Optional dependency-bound checks support reuse; formal release readiness retains its evidence contract.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Jerry SDLC to deliver this change with the smallest sufficient workflow and checks.
